:::{#exm-product-measure}
#### Product measures

- For the counting measure $\measure$ on the die rolls $D$,
  $(\measure \otimes \measure)(A \times B) = \abs{A} \abs{B}$,
  the number of pairs in $A \times B$.
  For example, the set of pairs in which both rolls are even is
  $\set{2, 4, 6} \times \set{2, 4, 6}$,
  with

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  (\measure \otimes \measure)(\set{2, 4, 6} \times \set{2, 4, 6}) &= 3 \cdot 3 \\
  &= 9
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  pairs.
- For Lebesgue measure $\lebesgue$ on $\reals$,

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  (\lebesgue \otimes \lebesgue)([0, 2] \times [0, 3]) &= 2 \cdot 3 \\
  &= 6,
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  the area of the rectangle.

:::
